title: It was love at first site, but...
text: It was love at first site, but.... At first I loved my new butter dish. It really looks very nice on my counter.  I like the little handle to pull the lid off. After only hand washing,  it has began to get crazing. Little fine lines throughout. It does kinda of add to the vintage look of it. It’s still a keeper!

product_metadata.title: Butter Dish with Lid Handle Cover, 6.9 Inch Ceramic Keeper, Cream White
features: VINTAGE DESIGN- The vintage style of lettering and design exudes refinement and high quality, giving your home a more classy vibe and contemporary style.
UPGRADED SIZE- We've upgraded vintage butter dish to a larger new version. The new size is 6.9"L x 4.5"H x 3.7"W, which could hold around 250g of butter.
HEXAGONAL HANDLE & BRONZE SEAL- No accidental slips of the hand with this convenient and uniquely shaped handle. The bronze detail with its engraved lettering elevates the butter dish in appearance.
VARIOUS USAGE- This butter dish is great for adding a vintage pop whilst eating breakfast, lunch or dinner! The white porcelain not only looks beautiful but keeps butter cool, fresh, and tasty.
APPROVED - Non-toxic material (Lead & Cadmium FREE), and freezer/refrigerator safe.
description: Upgrade size: 6.9"L x 3.7"W x 4.5"H Classic design coordinates with most kitchen décor. White porcelain covered dish keeps butter cool and fresh. Perfectly shaped to hold a stick of butter. Dish includes a ridge inside to keep butter from sliding, less mess! Top knob for easy gripping Top rack dishwasher safe.
